title: A Claude scope that cannot be named in a command still gets an unscoped update and an unscoped remedy (ruling 26 iii)
description: Introduced by QCLI-380 (#290, 5d408af) and pinned by its own test. When the deciding Claude row has a scope that is not a plain token, plainScope() drops --scope, so agents --update-instructions --target claude RUNS `claude plugin update opum-quest@opum` with no --scope, and the disabled remedy prints `claude plugin enable opum-quest@opum` unscoped. A command without --scope acts at Claude DEFAULT scope, which may be a different row from the one that decided the state. Ruling 26(iii) (opum-doc ADR Amendment 4) forbids this: an update names its deciding scope and never touches a row the reported state did not come from. MEASURED on origin/dev: test/qcli380-plugin-output-sanitised.test.ts "a scope that is not a plain token never reaches the update argv" asserts the calls [claude plugin list --json, claude plugin update opum-quest@opum], and it passes. lore-cli fixed the same defect in LCLI-593 (opum-ai/lore-cli#297, merged 46133fc0, review finding b). claudeScopeUnnamable(runtime, scope) is true for claude when the scope is not a plain token; the installed and disabled remedies become UNNAMABLE_SCOPE_REMEDY prose, and updateLorePlugin runs nothing and reports update not-run with updateDetail "the deciding scope could not be named in a command". Precedes, and is separate from, QCLI-382 (which tightens the token regex itself).

acceptanceCriteria.text: With a Claude deciding scope that is not a plain token, agents --update-instructions --target claude runs nothing beyond the list and reports update not-run, proven by a fake runtime that logs every call

The installed and disabled remedies for such a scope are prose naming claude plugin list --json and the row own --scope, never a runnable unscoped claude plugin command; the text matches lore-cli UNNAMABLE_SCOPE_REMEDY at 46133fc0 with the plugin id swapped
The QCLI-380 test that asserts an unscoped update runs is corrected; cited against lore-cli 46133fc0 and ruling 26(iii); bun run check exits 0
